text:
marie: quick heads-up — I'm scheduling a 60m cross-surface design huddle to walk through the unified client config (API + JS SDK + Console UX). Need runtime + ux + pm + qa. Two candidate slots: Thu 4/6 10am PT or Fri 4/7 1pm PT. Which works? I'll keep it async-friendly, attach a short readiness checklist. Please RSVP with :+1: or :eyes:.

devin: +1 for Thu 4/6 10am PT. scope: code + migration steps + API contract? Also can we get a canary/fallback plan on the agenda.

alex: I can do Fri afternoon only. pinging @samir for runtime perf and @irene for security signoff.

samir: I can join Thu if it's 10am PT. I'll bring the perf numbers (latency p95 at equip with 8k tokens). need a short perf slide — can someone paste the export path?

marie: perfect. pre-read link: https://internal.redwood/s/PR-1234 (short notes). Readiness checklist (two-minute skim recommended):
```
- TL;DR of change + user-facing behavior
- API contract diffs (schema)
- SDK surface changes + migration notes
- Console UI mockups (screenshots)
- Runtime perf expectations + any quantized model notes
- Rollout plan: canary + fallback + feature flags
- QA smoke tests + perf checklists
```

irene: security can join Fri 1pm PT only. If we go Thu, I'll do async review — share threat model bullets in the doc.

devin: can we add a section for "breaking change detection" and owners? I'll drop a quick PR in the doc.

marie: noted — added owners column in the doc. action items: samir to paste perf numbers, alex to attach SDK diff, devin to add detection plan, irene to add threat bullets. I'll create a calendar invite once we get a majority RSVP. calendar-bot: tentative event created: "Unified client review" Thu 4/6 10:00 PT — respond to confirm. :calendar:

alex: I'll aim to switch calendar and join Thu if possible. If not, I'll record screen share.

devin: ok locking Thu unless >=2 vetoes by EOD today.

samir: thumbs for Thu, recording ok.

irene: leaving :eyes: on doc, will post findings by EOD.

marie: thanks everyone — I'll post final invite + agenda (10m goals, 30m walkthrough, 15m design feedback, 5m action items). Please keep pre-read short — 2 pages max. :sparkles:
